title: Construction of a New Highway Bridge and Road Infrastructure
description: The Ministry of Transport is seeking a qualified contractor for the design and construction of a 450-meter highway bridge, road pavement, drainage systems, earthworks, traffic barriers, and associated civil engineering infrastructure. The contractor must have extensive experience in bridge construction, structural engineering, road works, heavy construction equipment, and civil engineering project management. IT services, cloud infrastructure, and software development are not part of this procurement.
